classification.difficultyReason: Recognise an angle of elevation measured upwards from the horizontal.

content.prompt: A girl views a kite at an angle of elevation of $28^{\circ}$. Which diagram shows this?

spec.description: Rising line of sight, horizontal base, vertical right side, right-angle marker and dashed vertical ray at the lower-left vertex. Bold option label A.
spec.mathematics: The supplied 28° is between the upward vertical ray and the rising line of sight, rather than the horizontal.
spec.answerVisibility: The given 28° remains visible; no answer annotation is included.

spec.description: Horizontal top side, vertical right side, descending line of sight and right-angle marker at the upper-right vertex. Bold option label B.
spec.mathematics: The supplied 28° is between the horizontal top side and the descending line of sight at the upper-left vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: The given 28° remains visible; no answer annotation is included.

spec.description: Horizontal base, vertical right side, rising line of sight and right-angle marker at the lower-right vertex. Bold option label C.
spec.mathematics: The supplied 28° is between the horizontal base and the rising line of sight at the lower-left vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: The given 28° remains visible; no answer annotation is included.

answer.worked: An angle of elevation is measured upwards from the horizontal to the line of sight. Diagram C shows this angle as $28^{\circ}$. Correct answer: C.
